positions.description:
Program Manager supporting USAF

Project Lead for IFG

positions.title: Software Engineer Stf
positions.description:
Integration & Test Engineer working product development and prototyping 

Program Manager supporting USAF

positions.title: Senior - Application/Production Support
positions.description: Supported the AT&T Field Operations Organization by handling Application Production Support for the Field and Service Transformation (FaST) BPM app, the Employee Automated Scheduling Environment (EASE) app, and the Real-time, Operational, Scheduling Tool for Enterprise Resources (ROSTER) app. Responsibilities include supporting the aforementioned software development DevOps teams by leveraging the CI/CD tools over the CDP platform for continuous integration and deployment to satisfy the needs of our clients. Additionally, extra focus is concentrated on providing database management, system configurations, deployment validation support, platform/application monitoring and alarming, defect management, process improvement, and overall web service and micro service support. As a member of the Application Production Support team, the goal was to provide an effortless customer experience by collaborating with IT and development teams to deliver the wants and needs of our clients, and essentially the business.

positions.title: SENIOR-Network Support
positions.description: Skills: Kubernetes · SQL · Root Cause Analysis

positions.title: Sr. Specialist - Network Support
positions.description:
Supported Field Operations & Care Planning (FOC-P) department supporting 51+ work centers in client and system support for Exception Manager (EXMGR), which supports the management and distribution of work items and service orders. My focus was to leverage fallout management, automation and user emulation tools to decrease requests for manual assistance (RMA's) handled manually by all centers that my team supports. In addition, weekly client requests were administered through creating ITC's and RD's which include routing and system changes to increase optimization. 

Assisted teammate to complete successful duplication of critical processes/programs in Visual Basic (VB) to avoid dramatic increase in manual work for centers. This included running programs in VB and running queries in Teradata SQL Assistant.

Other side projects thus far have included running monthly tech stat reports for the Mechanized Loop Assignment Center (MLAC), converting reports in the DESKI to WEBI Conversion project, and supporting releases and upgrades for EXMGR.

positions.title: Student Intern - Technical 1
positions.description:
Was involved in 3 major projects that resulted in the reduction of costs, management of internal customers, and the optimization of new software releases.
1) Conducted continuous Fallout Analysis for submitted tickets that were disconnected or dropped from the wire-line network
2) Was assigned the role of 'single point of contact' in project management to manage the conversion process from one intelligence system to another
3) Analyzed and corrected requirements and layout for a new time reporting system to be implemented

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Conducted research on Thermal Analysis for Lockheed Martin by utilizing Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) through modeling. ANSYS FLUENT was the main source of analysis.

company.name: The University of Texas at El Paso

positions.title: Pacific Northwestern National Laboratory (PNNL)
positions.description:
Studied the Power Grid and it's use of Smart Grid Technologies. Worked consistently with two teammates to study the effects of thermostatic devices and their role in power consumption through MATLAB analysis. 
Concluded that future field projects must obtain more accurate readings that consist of shorter timestamps to capture exact power pulse shapes of dryers and water heaters.
positions.insights: Skills: Modeling · Cross-functional Team Leadership · Matlab · Power Distribution

positions.title: Intern/Manufacturing
positions.description:
Supervisor for the Trim IP Line		Summer 2007
-Worked in unison with Union and Salary workers while supervising Union employees to gain a general understanding of how people work and think in an automotive industry.
-Maintained supervision for the Instrument Panel (IP) Line while ensuring that a perfect IP was built.
-Practiced the Manufacturing side of GM through improving quality, throughput, maintaining a safe working environment, reducing cost and downtime, managing 35 employees on a day-to-day basis, and attending daily meetings with Upper Management to seek process improvement.
positions.insights: Skills: Manufacturing · Cross-functional Team Leadership · Management · Interpersonal Skills

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at El Paso

honors.title: National Science Foundation (NSF) Science Masters Program Scholarship

volunteerExperiences.description: I am volunteering my time with the AT&T We Teach Science DeSoto RTM Program as a part of Aspire Mentoring Academy to improve high school success leading to college and career readiness by investing in my local community in Dallas, TX.

projects.title: NASA TSGC
projects.description:
-I was part of a 6 member team that approached the design of a Mars Water Works system with a Systems Engineering point of view.
-We partook in the Texas Space Grant Consortium (TSGC) Design Challenge in Houston, TX and displayed our mock-up of the rover water recovery subsystem.

projects.title: Fan Cooled Electronics Cabinet Analysis
projects.description:
-Performed a thermal analysis on an aircraft electronic cabinet under various conditions. 
-Developed a training manual on thermal analysis meeting systems engineering standards.
-Ran simulations on ANSYS FLUENT to determine the interactions of air flow throughout the entire system while comparing them to hand written calculations.
